intro: Everything here is a clue, not a finding. A row is on this page because a state DOT list or a manufacturer says something about Buy America, but no state DOT list prints that exact model number as compliant for projects obligated on or after Oct 1, 2026 (manufactured in the US and more than 55% domestic component cost). The fixture pages show only rows that pass that test. Each row quotes what the source says and names what is missing.
fiber_intro: Fiber optic cable and optical fiber are construction materials under 2 CFR 184: every manufacturing step, including the fiber preform and draw, must be in the United States, and there is no 55% test. Connectors, jumpers and housings are manufactured products under 23 CFR 635.410.

conduit_intro: Steel conduit is an iron or steel product (23 CFR 635.410(b): all manufacturing processes, including galvanizing, in the US). HDPE conduit is a construction material (2 CFR 184.6(a)(2): all manufacturing processes from combining the plastic inputs to final form in the US). Neither has a 55% test.
